## `Cursor`

```python
op.Cursor(graph, name)
```

Cursor A or B of a graph: a marker on one point of a trace.

`graph.cursor("A", trace, 10)` places the cursor at point index 10. Check `is_set` before reading coordinates or the point index. Reading an unset cursor raises `OresmeError`.

**Properties**

- `name` (read-only)
- `is_set` (read-only)
- `trace` (read-only)
- `point` (read/write) · Index of the point the cursor is on. Assign to move the cursor.
- `x` (read-only)
- `y` (read-only)

### `Cursor.remove`

```python
remove()
```
